positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Founded in 2011, Cirrus Insight sales enablement platform for Gmail and Outlook offers an all-in-one sales productivity platform with world-class Salesforce integration. The leader in managing sales processes right from your inbox, 250,000 professionals use Cirrus Insight to increase productivity. Fortune 500 companies and freelancers use Cirrus Insight for email tracking, email templates, drip campaigns, follow up reminders, meeting scheduling, attachment tracking, and world-class Salesforce integration. Cirrus Insight has been on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies for three consecutive years.
